title: Banking account hierarchy
goal: Represent specialized accounts and account-owned financial records.

rubric.must: CheckingAccount, SavingsAccount, and BusinessAccount have hollow-triangle generalization arrows pointing to abstract Account.
Account has filled composition diamonds to LedgerEntry and Statement.
Customer is associated with Account using visible 1 and 0..* multiplicities.
InterestPolicy is visibly an interface and SavingsAccount has a directed association to it.
Account visibly shows protected # number, private - balance, and public + credit operation.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the umlclass exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly represents the requested account inheritance, composed records, customer multiplicities, policy interface and association, and Account member visibility. Connections are traceable and labels readable; no material overlaps or cropping are visible.

items.evidence: CheckingAccount, SavingsAccount, and BusinessAccount connect through hollow triangles pointing to abstract Account.
Filled composition diamonds appear at the Account end of the connections to LedgerEntry and Statement; both show 0..*.
Customer connects to Account with multiplicity 1 at Customer and 0..* at Account.
InterestPolicy is marked «interface», and SavingsAccount has a directed association to it labeled “uses”.
Account shows protected # number, private - balance, and public + credit(amount: Money): void.
